propositions: The eval/calibration library excludes activated project code-review criteria because _code_review_prompt_id lacks repository context and calibrate_criterion has no code-review membership branch.

_code_review_prompt_id must accept optional repo_root parameter to admit both built-in physical ids and logical ids from code_review.registry.effective_criteria(repo_root) mapped via criterion_prompt_id.
calibrate_criterion must route to code-review arm only when repo_root is provided and criterion_id belongs to effective_criteria(repo_root), otherwise retain plan-review path unchanged.
EvalError from load_eval_spec in the code-review arm must be caught and re-raised as a located error containing the logical criterion_id.
Project code-review calibration requires explicit repository root while repo-root-absent and plan-review callers preserve current behavior.
